Name: AccessClinicalData@NIAID (ACDN)
Notes: Requires a DAR to DUA process.  AccessClinicalData@NIAID is a NIAID cloud-based, secure data platform that enables sharing of and access to data sets from NIAID COVID-19 and other sponsored clinical trials for the basic and clinical research community.

Name: TB Portals
Notes: Data download with DUA and extension tool based exploration and download https://tbportals.niaid.nih.gov/what-are-the-tb-portals  The API is token based and described at https://datasharing.tbportals.niaid.nih.gov/#/data-api
